title: Initialize Without Access Control
description: The initialize function lacks onlyOwner/initializer modifiers. Anyone could reinitialize the contract.
recommendation: Add the initializer modifier (for UUPS/Transparent) or onlyOwner modifier.

title: Upgrade Without Access Control
description: The upgradeTo function lacks access control. Anyone could upgrade the contract implementation.
recommendation: Add onlyOwner or onlyRole modifier to upgradeTo.

title: Reentrancy Vulnerability
description: External call followed by state update. Vulnerable to reentrancy attacks.
recommendation: Apply Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern: update state before making external calls.

title: Missing Access Control on mint
snippet: 15 | function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {
description: This function lacks access control modifiers or require checks.
recommendation: Add onlyOwner/onlyRole modifier or a require(msg.sender == owner) check.

title: Delegatecall Usage
description: delegatecall executes code in the caller's context. Can lead to unexpected state changes.
recommendation: Minimize delegatecall usage. Ensure the target address is trusted.

title: Selfdestruct Usage
description: selfdestruct can destroy a contract and force ETH to an arbitrary address.
recommendation: Avoid selfdestruct. Consider alternative lifecycle management.

title: Weak Randomness Using Block Variables
description: Block variables are predictable and can be manipulated by miners.
recommendation: Use Chainlink VRF or a commit-reveal scheme.

title: Public setPrice Without Access Control
description: setPrice function is publicly accessible. Anyone can manipulate the price oracle.
recommendation: Add onlyOwner or onlyRole modifier to setPrice.

title: tx.origin Used for Authorization
description: tx.origin should not be used for authorization. Can lead to phishing attacks.
recommendation: Use msg.sender instead of tx.origin for authentication.

title: Unchecked External Call
description: External call return value is not checked. If the call fails, the transaction won't revert.
recommendation: Always check the return value of external calls using require(success).

title: Unlimited Token Approval
description: Using type(uint256).max for token approvals gives unlimited spending power.
recommendation: Use exact approval amounts or increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.

title: Spot Price from AMM Reserves
description: Using AMM spot price (getReserves) is vulnerable to flash loan attacks.
recommendation: Use a TWAP oracle like Chainlink or Uniswap V3 TWAP.

title: Timestamp Equality Check
description: Using block.timestamp with equality checks is dangerous.
recommendation: Use > or < with a safe buffer instead of equality.

title: Approve Without Limit Check
description: approve is called. Consider checking for existing allowance to prevent front-running.

title: Timestamp Comparison Without Tolerance
description: block.timestamp comparison without tolerance. Miners can influence timestamps slightly.
recommendation: Consider adding a tolerance margin for block.timestamp comparisons.
